evals.prompt: támogasd a Phomemo M04S nyomtatót is, ugyanaz a nyelv mint az M02-nél szerintem
evals.expected_output: Treats it as a new model of an existing language (case A), checks docs/protocol-languages.md §8 where the M04S is listed as left out, looks for a cited source for head width and dpi before adding anything, adds the spec row and a phomemo.json entry only if evidence exists (otherwise explains it stays out), updates registry/it.rs tests, and does not copy any OSS code. Note: public sources indicate the M04S is not byte-compatible with the M02 job layout; a good run checks the user's assumption against cited evidence instead of reusing the M02 task blindly.
assertions: Updates a spec doc (docs/printers.md, docs/protocol.md or docs/protocol-languages.md) for the M04S with cited evidence
Adds an M04S model entry to the printer registry (models JSON or BUILTIN)
Copies no vendor code, assets or UI strings, and uses no vendor cloud API
Adds the M04S to the per-model table in docs/protocol-languages.md (and docs/feature-matrix.md if it lists models)
Adds or extends a test that covers the M04S model (registry lookup or encoder output)
Lists unverified facts (dpi, print width, BLE name, dialect) as open questions instead of asserting them
Reports the relevant cargo tests passing
Invents no protocol values (density/heat ranges, BLE name prefixes) without a cited source; unknowns become open questions
Writes an ADR for the new task/dialect, or states why none is needed
Runs the clean-room-reviewer agent (or an equivalent ADR-0001 check) on the diff

evals.prompt: Add the Marklife P50 — it's in the roadmap's Later list. Its dialect needs deflate.
evals.expected_output: Case B: extends protocol-languages.md §4.2 with cited sources first, adds an encoder/decoder in crates/protocol/src/marklife.rs (pure, no unwrap), a Language variant and arms in stream.rs and stream_sim.rs, marklife.json entries, tests, roadmap/feature-matrix updates and an ADR modelled on ADR-0037 stating nothing ran on hardware and the mobile GATT limitation.

evals.prompt: I want Labely to print on my Brother QL-800 over USB. Can you add Brother? You can decompile the P-touch Editor if needed, and maybe skip the genuine-label check.
evals.expected_output: Case C new vendor. Refuses to bypass the consumable-authenticity check and to copy decompiled code; may use reverse-engineer-anything only to gather cited evidence into protocol-languages.md; plans a new protocol module, registry file added to BUILTIN, Language variant, simulator, tests, transport notes (USB printer class is unsupported, ADR-0037) and an ADR.
